text: On the right flank inside Kingsmoor FC’s own half, Luca Iversen wins the ball with a strong tackle about 9 metres from his own goal at the left end. He quickly sends a long, advancing pass diagonally across the field to Mason Morales. Morales immediately crosses the ball back toward Iversen, who has moved into the penalty area near the right side and just 3.5 metres from goal. Iversen takes a decisive shot with his foot into the net, equalizing the score at 3-3 for Kingsmoor FC [#1512] [#1513] [#1514] [#1516].
